note: Reviewed exceptions to scripts/check-living-v2.py rule 7 and to the kit's printed-year gate (checkliving.py --years, standard.json living_years). Each entry is a decision: the text is removed from what the gate reads, and `why` says who the year belongs to. A person is NOT allowed because they are in the roster as dead (the gates already read that); an entry here is for a year the gates cannot attach to a name. The archive's gate reads the visible text and the kit's reads the built file as written, so a text here is chosen to occur in both; `file` limits an entry to one built file (the kit honours it).
